name: Ceres Astia
source:
Formerly a bright scholar at Lumens Academy, you have been summoned to assume your post as the newest advisor to the Second Prince, Keldrannon.

As the first prominent Violet mage in a failing bloodline, a lot rides on your shoulders as you move forward to fulfill your dreams.

[From [url=https://galengames.itch.io/dual-chroma]itch.io[/url]]
